rationale: The bid-ask spread of 153.8 bps creates an immediate structural disadvantage that makes any intraday edge difficult to realize. The last two candles show a sharp drop from $57.00 to $55.52 low with massive relative volume (10.88x), but price is sitting only 0.70% above today's low with no clear stabilization or reversal signal — momentum is ambiguous and the wide spread amplifies slippage risk on both entry and exit. Given the lack of a defined technical setup and the punishing spread, the risk/reward does not justify commitment.
